headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 Instant, enhancing ChatGPT with smarter responses and personalization.

items.title: GPT-5.5 Instant: smarter, clearer, and more personalized
items.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.5 Instant, an upgrade to ChatGPT's default model, promising smarter and more accurate responses, reduced hallucinations, and enhanced personalization controls. This update aims to improve user interaction by providing clearer and contextually relevant answers. The model focuses on refining user experience through improved understanding and response generation. OpenAI plans to use these improvements to further bridge the gap between AI capabilities and user expectations.
